Name: German Shepherd Bundle
Author: deadduch
Description:
Edit: This mod is old, and I never intend to update it to the new content. If anyone wants to take this and update it for themselves/others, permission granted.

A bundle of German Shepherd skins to change the look of your pet. Includes 10 skins:
[list]
[*]Tan Classic
[*]Brown Classic
[*]Bicolour Classic
[*]White
[*]Black
[*]Husky Mix 1
[*]Husky Mix 2
[*]Ghost
[/list]
Also includes 2 custom German Shepherd Skins:
[list]
[*]"Gunny"
[*]"Gunny" Classic
[/list]
Find the thread of my to do list and ask for requests on this thread: [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-pet-skins-beroins-mod.109346/]http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-pet-skins-beroins-mod.109346/[/url]

To Do for this mod:[list]
[*]German Shepherd Poodle Mix
[*]Newfoundland Shepherd Mix
[/list]

Mod Compatibilities

Using the Cursors.xnb in this mod will overwrite any other mod that has made changes to that image.

There is an optional file called the German Shepherd Bundle - Animal Crossing Digspot that makes the Animal Crossing Digspot mod compatible with the German Shepherd Bundle.  Installation instructions inside.[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/57/?]
[/url]
Animal Crossing Digspot mod by Lechet can be found here:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18?]http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18?[/url]
